sharing violations do not recall dirty caches; readonly, directory, delete-on-close and conflicting native opens receive no unsupported cache grant
a lease-form ACK for a classic oplock is rejected and finishes the recall without leaving native exclusion stuck
two encrypted sessions on one transport renew independent cache authority and route breaks/ACKs with their own keys; a foreign-session ACK cannot release another open
native host reads/writes wait for SMB recall; dirty client data flushes before host access and the original handle observes subsequent native writes
SET_INFO recalls before mutation, permits cached flush while pending and applies EOF after ACK without replaying side effects
a new cached CREATE is announced before its own compound SET_INFO recall; asynchronous retries preserve the inherited FileId through the dependent READ
NFSv3 READ on an existing handle returns JUKEBOX during native recall; repeated retries leave SMB flush/ACK live and the next read returns current data
DAV GET returns a retryable response while a cache recall is pending and reads freshly flushed bytes after ACK
another transport cannot ACK the holder FileId; CLOSE flushes/releases authority and wakes the peer CREATE
unacknowledged recall fences the holder transport and open while the conflicting client completes after native exclusion releases
credential revocation closes the cache-bearing transport and releases native exclusion without requiring a client request
stalled identity RPC cannot hold the cache transport past its authority: independent watchdog closes it before IPC timeout and autonomous worker expiry releases native exclusion
